text: The authors state their research direction rests on Assumption 1, that user intentions can be learned to a sufficiently high accuracy, i.e. that with enough model capacity and the right training algorithms the user's intentions can be extracted from data. They acknowledge adversarial vulnerability and poor out-of-distribution performance as relevant but not contradictory.
title: Assumption 1: user intentions can be learned to sufficiently high accuracy
